tasks.short: Evaluate curricula, teaching methods, programmes, effectiveness, efficiency, use, and compliance

steps.what: Assemble curriculum, outcome and regulation evidence

loop.input: checked findings and cited internal evidence
loop.output: evaluation draft with separated effectiveness and compliance findings
loop.check: Administrator traces every statement to the evidence pack before it is used.
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported or conflicting findings are written manually and escalated for review.
loop.why_not_simpler: The evaluation needs coherent prose from varied documents and observations.

tasks.design: A {BI} view assembles data already held in school records and a {WORKFLOW} register tracks recommendations and review dates. The administrator evaluates curricula, teaching and compliance evidence; a draft helper only organises conclusions they have checked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effectiveness and regulatory fit depend on local teaching context and professional judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Common evidence fields and a recommendation register reduce manual assembly of recurring reviews.
tasks.still_hard: The administrator still decides whether evidence supports a curriculum change and whether an exception is acceptable.
tasks.human_edge: They can distinguish a poor metric from a real teaching problem and take responsibility for compliance.

ambition.what: Review the highest-risk curriculum findings at each term boundary.

tasks.altitude: The administrator interprets evidence and improves programmes rather than rebuilding evaluation packs.

evidence.claim: Policy and obligation registers can track versions, owners and reviews.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: evaluation evidence assembled through recommendations and next review recorded.
Input contract: curriculum identifier, outcome measure, observation reference, requirement reference, finding and owner; curriculum staff supply inputs; a controlled evidence pack is the fallback.
No existing scheduled report runtime is counted as labour saved; only administrator assembly and record entry are reduced.
Incremental upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers evidence definitions and review rules.
unknowns: Which regulations and local standards apply to each programme.
Which outcome measures are reliable enough for comparison.
research_questions: How long does the administrator currently spend assembling evidence?
Which recommendations repeatedly miss their review date?

already_counted.description: Evaluation, compliance assessment and draft review

incremental.description: Maintain evidence definitions and review rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Curriculum and compliance judgement remain human; savings are limited to assembling evidence, drafting and recommendation tracking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and lead professional development for teachers, administrators, and support staff

steps.what: Collect professional development needs and completions

tasks.design: Configuration in {LMS} and {CALENDAR} turns confirmed development activities into enrolments, reminders and completion records. The administrator selects the development need, designs the activity and leads it; automation is limited to coordination and reporting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Development value depends on staff needs and the quality of facilitation, not on a booking process.
tasks.enabler_now: A common activity brief and enrolment record can remove repeated scheduling and completion chasing.
tasks.still_hard: The administrator must choose relevant learning and respond to participants in the room.
tasks.human_edge: They can adapt the session to staff experience and make development practical for the school.

ambition.what: Offer support staff a visible development path alongside teachers and administrators.

tasks.altitude: The administrator evaluates which activities change practice instead of reconciling attendance lists.

evidence.claim: Learning systems can record enrolment and completion.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: development need collected through completion and follow-up recorded.

Input contract: staff role, capability need, activity, facilitator, date, capacity and completion state; staff and facilitators supply the fields; an administrator-managed session list is the fallback.
Existing automatic reminders are not counted as a new saving; only manual scheduling and reconciliation time is reduced.
Incremental upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers catalogue and attendance-rule updates.
unknowns: Whether attendance is already reliably recorded in the learning system.
research_questions: Where do participants drop out between invitation and completion?
Which development activities lead to observable changes in teaching or support practice?

already_counted.description: Activity planning, schedule review and facilitation

incremental.description: Maintain activity catalogue and attendance rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Planning and facilitation remain human; savings depend on how much scheduling and completion reconciliation is currently manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create school improvement plans using student performance data

steps.what: Prepare student performance data for planning
Interpret performance gaps and contributing factors

loop.input: selected issues, hypotheses and checked performance measures
loop.output: improvement plan draft with goals, measures, owners and milestones
loop.check: Administrator verifies each goal and measure against the planning dataset before review.
loop.stop: One draft per cycle; incomplete measures return to manual planning.
loop.why_not_simpler: The plan combines structured measures with narrative choices and linked actions.

steps.what: Test plan with teachers and leaders
Store plan draft and review milestones

tasks.design: A {DATA_PLATFORM} view prepares a checked planning dataset and flags missing values; {DOCS} holds a versioned improvement-plan draft and {WORKFLOW} tracks milestones. The administrator interprets the data and tests the plan with staff before it is used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performance data can describe gaps but cannot settle their causes or the best improvement action.
tasks.enabler_now: A repeatable dataset and plan structure reduce manual reconciliation between reports and documents.
tasks.still_hard: The administrator must challenge misleading measures and build a plan staff can implement.
tasks.human_edge: They combine local knowledge, professional judgement and staff commitment when choosing improvement work.

ambition.what: Review plan milestones against current performance data each term.

tasks.altitude: The administrator tests hypotheses and removes blockers instead of formatting plan tables.

reach.learn: educational measure definitions and exception handling

evidence.claim: Structured data can support a human-reviewed planning draft.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: performance data prepared through improvement plan draft and milestones recorded.

Input contract: measure identifier, period, cohort, value, data-quality flag, priority, owner and milestone; data staff provide measures and school leaders provide priorities; a controlled spreadsheet is the fallback.
Scheduled data refresh time is system runtime and is not counted as labour saving.
Incremental upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers measure definitions and exception review.
unknowns: Which student data fields are complete and legally usable for planning.
Who approves the final school improvement plan.
research_questions: How often do data-quality issues change a proposed priority?
Which milestone measures can staff act on within one term?

already_counted.description: Gap interpretation, plan review and staff challenge

incremental.description: Maintain measure definitions and data-quality exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Interpretation and staff challenge are retained; savings come from preparing data, structuring the draft and milestone tracking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine funding allocations and authorize purchases for school resources

steps.what: Consolidate budget, stock and purchase requests
Determine fund allocations for school resources

tasks.design: A {PROCUREMENT} workflow checks a request against the administrator's recorded allocation decision and creates an authorized purchase only from the approved allocation snapshot. The administrator decides allocations, checks the request and gives the version-bound approval before the system writes the authorization.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget allocation is a trade-off between educational need, timing and available funds.
tasks.enabler_now: Purchasing records can match a request against a current allocation without rekeying it between systems.
tasks.still_hard: The administrator must choose priorities and challenge requests that are technically within budget but not justified.
tasks.human_edge: They weigh the consequences of resource choices for pupils, staff and the school’s commitments.

ambition.what: Review unspent allocations and high-demand resource requests each month.

tasks.altitude: The administrator manages resource trade-offs and exceptions instead of copying requests into a budget worksheet.

evidence.claim: Structured request and allocation fields can be checked before a human-approved authorization.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: purchase request assembled through authorized purchase written after approval.

Input contract: request identifier, cost centre, amount, resource type, allocation version, requester and justification; requester and finance records provide the fields; manual verification is the fallback for missing or conflicting fields.
The system does not authorize a purchase until the matching allocation snapshot is approved by the administrator.
Existing scheduled budget updates are system runtime and are not counted as saved labour.
Incremental upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers allocation codes and exception rules.
unknowns: Which purchase values require a second approver.
Whether the procurement system stores immutable allocation versions.
research_questions: How often do requests need rework because coding or allocation data is missing?
What proportion of purchases are already authorized through an existing workflow?

already_counted.description: Allocation choice, request check and approval

incremental.description: Maintain allocation codes and exception rules

approvals.approved_version: allocation snapshot tied to purchase request version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Funding allocation, request checking and approval stay human; savings are limited to consolidation and creating the authorized record after the approved snapshot.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The administrator retains educational, compliance and spending judgement while using dependable evidence packs and versioned records.
reach: Partner with curriculum coordinators on evidence quality.
Partner with procurement coordinators on request controls.
role.ambitious_version: A school leader who can examine programme, staff-development, improvement and spending choices with their evidence and follow-through visible.
